exposure: Cervical examination at the time of presentation
Preterm premature rupture of membranes in a previous pregnancy
Gestational age at entry to prenatal care
Gestational age at rupture of membranes
Termination of pregnancy (labor induction or dilation and evacuation)
outcome: Readmission to the hospital within 6 weeks
cohort: Women with preterm premature rupture of membranes between 14 0/7 and 23 6/7 weeks' gestation with singleton or twin pregnancies
finding: Expectant management for preterm premature rupture of membranes at <24 weeks' gestation was associated with a significantly increased risk of maternal morbidity when compared to termination of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Of women who chose expectant management, 36.2% delivered via cesarean delivery with 56.4% non-low transverse uterine incisions.
